execution_notes.wrapper: use cmd.exe wrapper to capture the real python exit code: cmd /c "python ... 1> stdout.log 2> stderr.log"; before/after nvidia-smi appended to gpu_log
execution_notes.resume: same run_id plus --resume only for an interrupted run; never change batch size for that run_id (config fingerprint covers batch_size)
execution_notes.abort: >7500 MiB, competing GPU job, assert/OOM/non-finite loss: stop and report
execution_notes.no_parallel_gpu: one run at a time; validations are CPU-only
execution_notes.preserve: results/zeroshot_sft_v1_s42_{synthetic,refcoco}_v1.json + validation + details remain untouched; batch8 reruns use new run IDs

timing_estimate.total_lease_needed_minutes: 40 (requested), with stop rule to finish current run and report if over

lease_request.window: immediately after train-runner releases GPU-LEASE-T6SEEDS-20261109-08 and seed44 adapter is final (expected 21:00-21:40)
lease_request.scope: only the A/B pair and the listed six batch8 run_zeroshot commands (same-run_id --resume allowed); no other GPU work
lease_request.fallback_if_seed44_delayed: Lead may grant a first short lease for A/B + seed42/seed43 four runs; seed44 two runs in a second lease

final_deliverables.per_run: summary JSON + details JSONL + validation JSON for six batch8 runs
final_deliverables.ab_equivalence: results/eval_ab_equivalence.json (field-by-field counts, hashes, commands, GPU logs)
final_deliverables.three_seed_summary: results/eval_sft_v1_3seed_summary.json (per seed + mean, sample std ddof=1, min, max; per dataset and pooled; seed42 G3 weak-positive flagged)
final_deliverables.three_seed_table: report/tables/t6_sft_3seed_metrics.csv (dataset, seed, run_id, adapter sha256, n, acc@0.5, mIoU, parse_rate, invalid; plus mean±std rows)
final_deliverables.policy: report all three seeds; do not pick the best; batch1 seed42 stays as reference; negative or failed A/B goes to the failure ledger

naming_note: production run IDs follow the existing batch-1 convention sft_v1_s{42,43,44}_{synthetic,refcoco}_b8_v1; distinct from the batch-1 run IDs sft_v1_s{42,43,44}_{synthetic,refcoco}_v1
